additional_kwargs.reasoning_content: We need day with most runs created before Oct 28 2026. Use created_at < '2026-10-28'. Group by date (UTC) cast to date. Count. Order desc limit 1.

function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT created_at::date AS day_utc, COUNT(*) AS run_count
FROM runs
WHERE created_at < '2026-10-28'::date
GROUP BY day_utc
ORDER BY run_count DESC
LIMIT 1;"}
function.name: query_database

args.sql:
SELECT created_at::date AS day_utc, COUNT(*) AS run_count
FROM runs
WHERE created_at < '2026-10-28'::date
GROUP BY day_utc
ORDER BY run_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
